exec: (()=>{const S=window.__app.scene;let m=null;S.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.name==='ground:paving')m=o;});if(!m)return 'none';const t=m.material.map;const cv=t.image;const x=cv.getContext('2d');const d=x.getImageData(0,0,cv.width,cv.height).data;let r=0,g=0,b=0,n=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4*997){r+=d[i];g+=d[i+1];b+=d[i+2];n++;}return 'map avg rgb='+(r/n).toFixed(0)+','+(g/n).toFixed(0)+','+(b/n).toFixed(0)+' size='+cv.width+' colorSpace='+t.colorSpace})()
